rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip, matched to a single user. It retrieved the user’s orders via tools, correctly identified the delivered order containing the office chair, and did not invent any details. Before taking any action, the agent asked for explicit confirmation for the return; when the user chose to wait, it did not perform any write. When the user requested an exchange for the same item, the agent again sought explicit confirmation, then executed the exchange via the appropriate tool. The tool result showed “exchange requested,” and the agent’s final message accurately reflected that outcome, including correct payment and process details. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account, with no unsupported statements or policy violations.
